source.title: Junior School Curriculum Design: Indigenous Languages, Grade 8
source.notes: Filename confirmed against KICD's own Google Drive listing (kicd.ac.ke/cbc-materials/curriculum-designs/grade-eight-designs/, file id 1WEG5wJplprPae9blpB9oVyI1UaVrq-xj, whose /preview page title reads 'Indigenous Languages Grade 8 Design - Revised.pdf'). WebFetch reported it could not extract text from the PDF itself but saved it locally; Read then parsed the full PDF text natively (ISBN 978-9914-43-936-6, First Published 2023, Revised 2024). Strand/sub-strand headings, SLOs, and key inquiry questions below are transcribed verbatim. STRUCTURAL NOTE: this design uses two overlapping organisational views. A front-matter 'SUMMARY OF STRANDS AND SUB STRANDS' table presents three generic skill strands (Listening and Speaking / Reading / Writing, each with generic sub-strand categories like 'Reading comprehension', 'Extensive reading', etc., totalling 18 lessons apiece) plus a 6-lesson 'Showcasing Concepts and Skills in Indigenous Language (Exhibitions)' entry - but the actual body of the document is organised around 9 real-world THEMES (Gender Roles, ICT/Netiquette, Wildlife, Safety at School, Common Community Values, Indigenous Trade, Sports and Games, Indigenous Music, Inter-Ethnic Cohesion), each theme containing exactly one Listening & Speaking sub-strand, one Reading sub-strand, and one Writing sub-strand (2 lessons each) with genuinely different content per theme - matching the Grade 9 Indigenous Language pattern described in prior research. Following the body's organisation (themes as strands, since that is where the actual distinct content lives), each Theme is recorded here as a 'strand' with its three L&S/Reading/Writing components as subStrands. As with Grade 9, content is generic-English-medium (grammar concepts like tense, sentence construction, dialogue/poster/song writing, presentation skills) applied to indigenous-language-medium themes, not actual vocabulary in one specific mother tongue, since KICD's design does not prescribe a single indigenous language among Kenya's 40+ languages. All 9 themes carry genuinely distinct content (not the same theme retold three ways), confirming the Grade 9 finding holds at Grade 8 too.

subStrands.name: Listening for information
subStrands.notes: Sub-topics: gender roles, responding to questions.
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify gender roles from aural texts for information
Respond to questions on gender roles in the community from texts for comprehension
Recognise the importance of listening purposefully for comprehension
keyInquiryQuestions: How do we listen to get information from an aural text?
Why should some opportunities be equal among both girls and boys?

subStrands.name: Reading for comprehension
subStrands.notes: Sub-topics: vocabulary, direct and inferential questions, tense (present and past tense).
specificLearningOutcomes: Answer questions from texts related to the theme for comprehension
Use the vocabulary on the theme to construct sentences in appropriate tenses for communication
Embrace the use of interpersonal skills to enhance positive gender roles in society
keyInquiryQuestions: How can we differentiate between actions done in the past and in the present?
Why is it important to apply comprehension skills in reading?

subStrands.name: Essay writing - Expository essay
specificLearningOutcomes: Research on an issue related to the theme for information
Write an expository essay on gender roles for effective communication
Embrace the importance of organising ideas into a coherent sequence for communication
keyInquiryQuestions: How do we organise information logically in writing?
Why is it important to understand gender roles in the community?

subStrands.name: Listening for comprehension
subStrands.notes: Sub-topics: the internet, tense (future tense).
specificLearningOutcomes: Outline the advantages and disadvantages of the internet for information
Identify future tense from aural texts for information
Value the importance of listening attentively as a way of acquiring information
keyInquiryQuestions: How do we listen to acquire information?
Why is it important to observe netiquette when using the internet?

subStrands.name: Extensive reading - Library skills
subStrands.notes: Sub-topics: tracing resources, tracking reading progress, tense (future tense).
specificLearningOutcomes: Trace specific reading materials from online or print sources
Track their reading progress by creating a reading log
Embrace safe use of the internet as a source of information for lifelong learning
keyInquiryQuestions: How do we get information on something we want to understand more?
Why is it important to use the internet safely and cautiously?

subStrands.name: Social writing - Cards
subStrands.notes: Sub-topics: invitation card, appreciation card, congratulatory card.
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify the key components of a card for information
Design a card (invitation card, appreciation card, congratulatory card) for effective communication
Advocate for the role of social writing in enhancing communication
keyInquiryQuestions: Why do we present cards to people?
How can we make cards more appealing when designing them?

subStrands.name: Attentive listening
subStrands.notes: Sub-topics: common conversational errors, responding to questions.
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify common conversational errors for information
Respond to questions from an aural text for comprehension
Acknowledge the role of conversational skills in day-to-day communication
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is it important to interrupt politely in a conversation?
How do we avoid conflict with wild animals?

subStrands.name: Extensive Reading
subStrands.notes: Grade-appropriate texts. Sub-topics: vocabulary building, paraphrasing main idea.
specificLearningOutcomes: Explain vocabulary related to the theme for effective communication
Paraphrase the main idea from a text for comprehension
Embrace reading as a source of acquiring information
keyInquiryQuestions: Why should we read extensively?
Why is it important to take care of wildlife?
What can be done to avoid road accidents involving wild animals?

subStrands.name: Writing for information - Paragraphs
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify the features of a well-developed paragraph
Compose two well sequenced paragraphs on the theme for information
Acknowledge writing as a channel for addressing pertinent issues and ideas
keyInquiryQuestions: How do we write paragraphs?
Why is it important to preserve wildlife?

subStrands.name: Public speaking - Impromptu speech
subStrands.notes: Sub-topics: non-verbal cues, presentation.
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify the non-verbal cues in communication
Present a short talk on the theme using appropriate non-verbal cues for effective communication
Recognise the value of non-verbal cues in enhancing communication
keyInquiryQuestions: How do non-verbal cues enhance understanding?
Why is it important to follow the appropriate steps of first aid in case of an accident?

subStrands.name: Reading for information - Poetry
subStrands.notes: Sub-topics: responding to questions, vocabulary building, sentence construction.
specificLearningOutcomes: Respond to questions from texts for information
Create a glossary with words related to the theme for information
Construct sentences using the new vocabulary for effective communication
Appreciate the role of reading as a way of acquiring information
keyInquiryQuestions: Why should there be security measures in school?

subStrands.name: Writing to give information
subStrands.notes: Sub-topics: connectors of sequence, composition writing.
specificLearningOutcomes: Outline the steps of responding to an emergency in school, using connectors of sequence
Write a composition on the process of responding to an emergency in school
Recognise process writing as a way of passing information
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is it important to understand how to respond to an emergency?

strands.name: Theme 5: Common Community Values (Unity, Respect and Hard Work)

subStrands.name: Storytelling
subStrands.notes: Sub-topics: proverbs and wise sayings, re-telling stories, lessons learnt.
specificLearningOutcomes: Re-tell a short story on the theme for expression
Explain proverbs and wise sayings used in oral presentations for information
Embrace the common community values for lifelong learning
keyInquiryQuestions: Why is it important to pass culture from one generation to another?

subStrands.name: Reading for information
subStrands.notes: Sub-topics: vocabulary building, responding to questions.
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify vocabulary related to the theme for information
Respond to questions from texts for comprehension
Acknowledge the role of reading for acquisition of information
keyInquiryQuestions: Why are community values important?

subStrands.name: Creative writing - Poetry
subStrands.notes: Sub-topics: features of poems, aspects of style.
specificLearningOutcomes: Identify features of a poem for information
Write a simple poem on the theme for creative expression
Advocate for the use of poetry in the promotion of community values
keyInquiryQuestions: Why are poems important in transmitting culture?

subStrands.name: Self-expression - interviews

Observe the skills of turn-taking and interrupting politely in a dialogue for expression

Why is it important to take turns and interrupt politely in dialogues?

subStrands.name: Reading for comprehension - Play

Summarise the main ideas from a play for comprehension
Respond to questions from a play for comprehension
Acknowledge relating events and ideas to real life for life-long learning

How does indigenous trade differ from modern trade?

subStrands.name: Writing to give information - Dialogue
specificLearningOutcomes: Examine the features of a dialogue for effective writing
Create a dialogue on the theme for information
Acknowledge the importance of dialogue writing in communication

Why are values important when engaging in any business transaction?

subStrands.name: Presentation skills - Debate

specificLearningOutcomes: Identify vocabulary related to sports and games for information
Organise ideas logically for comprehension
Apply appropriate audience awareness skills during debate for expression
Acknowledge audience awareness skills in effective public presentations
keyInquiryQuestions: How do we ensure that the audience follows a presentation?
Why are sports and games important in modern living?

subStrands.name: Reading for information
subStrands.notes: Sub-topics: responding to questions, vocabulary building, summarising ideas.
specificLearningOutcomes: Answer questions from texts for information

Summarise the key ideas from texts for information
Embrace the acquisition of knowledge on sports and games through reading

Why should we engage in sports and games?

subStrands.name: Essay writing - Descriptive composition

specificLearningOutcomes: Identify descriptive words from a text on sports and games
Write a descriptive composition on a topic related to the theme for information
Advocate for use of appropriate descriptive words in communication

subStrands.name: Story telling - Ogre narrative

Retell an ogre narrative from the community for effective communication
Acknowledge the role of ogre narratives in the preservation of culture

Respond to questions from texts for comprehension
Use vocabulary related to the theme in sentence construction for comprehension

subStrands.name: Creative writing - Songs

specificLearningOutcomes: Outline the features of a song for information
Compose a simple song related to the theme for effective communication

subStrands.name: Functional Writing - Posters
